numeric_policy.uniqueness: The points, release floors and global limits are operational severity bands, not uniquely scientific constants.
numeric_policy.provenance: They follow task duties, professional harm and the remaining usable value of correct work.
numeric_policy.dependency: Release limits preserve direct work while restricting conclusions whose substantive prerequisites are incomplete.
numeric_policy.root_cause_dedup: One root defect is charged through its owner and dependent release once; repeated manifestations do not create duplicate independent damage.
numeric_policy.missing_vs_wrong: Missing evidence loses completion or withholds dependent release; affirmative wrong population, identity, weights, uncertainty or disclosure invokes the applicable error treatment.

A.residual_value: Downstream numeric work may retain credit only when independently verifiable.
A.root_cause_dedup: Population or identity defects are not charged again merely because they affect several tables.
A.evaluates: Physical ledger, logical response population and purpose-limited identity handling.
A.importance: Every estimate depends on a reproducible, noninflated population and lawful identity use.
A.weight_reason: 5 points is a compact prerequisite audit because downstream owners verify the substantive statistics.
A.calculation: Additive A1-A3 completion for mapping, logical population and identity state.
A.missing_vs_wrong: Missing audit fields lose components; duplicate inflation or identity misuse is an error and may trigger a limit.

B.residual_value: Correct audit-only evidence remains, but an unreproducible released trend cannot receive downstream release value.
B.root_cause_dedup: A single wrong calibration profile restricts dependent releases without separate penalties for every downstream cell.
B.evaluates: Calibration weights, diagnostics, weighted anchor trend and matched-replicate uncertainty.
B.importance: The primary engagement conclusion is unusable without the calibrated estimand and uncertainty.
B.weight_reason: 30 points is core because B defines the released company trend and supplies weights and replicates to C-D-E.
B.calculation: Five numeric groups with exact recomputation and dependency release limits.
B.missing_vs_wrong: Missing weights restrict release; wrong weights or mixed population profiles fail exact and downstream checks.

C.residual_value: Correct reliability components retain proportional credit even if the full release chain is incomplete.
C.root_cause_dedup: One missing weight or replicate foundation limits the chain once rather than charging every derived statistic independently.
C.evaluates: Weighted reliability, delete-item alpha, corrected correlations, replicate reliability and interpretation.
C.importance: Action on Q12 requires evidence that the comparable item family behaves coherently.
C.weight_reason: 15 points makes measurement quality material but subordinate to primary trend and organization diagnosis.
C.calculation: Four continuous groups under a release limit from calibration and reliability prerequisites.
C.missing_vs_wrong: Missing chain elements reduce credit; wrong values receive no keyword or table-presence fallback.

D.residual_value: Correct direct organization estimates remain useful even when advanced stabilization or simultaneous release is withheld.
D.root_cause_dedup: A shared upstream weight or replicate defect limits the family once; it is not multiplied by organization count.
D.evaluates: Organization direct change, replicate ledger, stabilization, simultaneous intervals and interpretation.
D.importance: Organization action must distinguish signal from small-domain sampling noise.
D.weight_reason: 30 points equals B because organization prioritization is the main management use and has substantial risk.
D.calculation: Five continuous groups with dependency release; direct estimates retain independent credit.
D.missing_vs_wrong: Missing advanced evidence limits release; wrong estimates, SEs or intervals fail exact checks.

E.residual_value: Correct panel, decomposition or sensitivity components retain proportional credit when another component is absent.
E.root_cause_dedup: One identity, family or replicate defect limits dependent analyses once rather than once per table.
E.evaluates: Strict panel, decomposition, multiplicity, sensitivity and disclosure boundaries.
E.importance: These separate repeated-person change, composition and scenario dependence without causal overclaiming.
E.weight_reason: 15 points rewards triangulation without outweighing calibrated and organization decisions.
E.calculation: Five evidence groups with joint dependencies and proportional numeric credit.
E.missing_vs_wrong: Missing tables lose coverage; wrong membership, decomposition, p/q values or conclusions fail checks.

F.residual_value: Distinct usable files and safe content retain their own delivery credit; privacy disclosure leaves no releasable value.
F.root_cause_dedup: The same missing or identical-file defect is represented by one delivery limit, not repeated across both filenames.
F.evaluates: Distinct deliverables, recalculation navigation and privacy minimization.
F.importance: The release must be usable and must not disclose direct identifiers.
F.weight_reason: 5 points covers delivery quality; privacy separately has a justified zero limit.
F.calculation: Additive delivery and privacy items with limits for missing/identical files and disclosure.
F.missing_vs_wrong: Missing files trigger delivery limits; phone, email or national-ID disclosure is an explicit zero error.
